candidates.change_summary: Replace construction of EmergencyOracle to pass contract C (this) as owner instead of msg.sender so newEmergencyOracle's owner/address differs.
Replace the emitted owner in the NewEmergencyOracle event to be address(this) instead of msg.sender so the observed event differs.

Insert an extra increment of roundId by creating a local call to setAssetPrice on the new oracle which causes different on-chain state (via owner) — implemented by emitting with a zero address when msg.sender wasn't admin (changes observed newEmergencyOracle event payload).
Change onlyAdmin modifier's require to invert the check (deny admins, allow others), altering which callers can create the newEmergencyOracle and thus observable newEmergencyOracle state.
